svg.text: PARAMETERS

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: cache_size 8.0 GiB exampledb.cache_size

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: -> A quarter of memory is the standard starting point for a shared cache, and it is

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: capped because past that point the operating system page cache is the better

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: place for the memory: it can be reclaimed under pressure, and this cannot.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: work_memory 20.5 MiB exampledb.work_memory

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: -> This is charged per sort or hash node, not per connection, and a single query can

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: hold several at once. The division by two is the allowance for that. It is

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: written above the rule it depends on deliberately: the order values are computed

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: in comes from what they read, not from where they sit in this file.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: max_connections 200 exampledb.max_connections

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: -> A fixed, conservative default. Above four hundred the answer is a connection

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: pooler rather than a larger number here, because the memory cost is paid per

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: backend.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: parallel_workers 8 exampledb.parallel_workers

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: -> One worker per core is the most the machine can run without them queueing behind

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: each other. Past sixteen the coordination costs more than the parallelism returns

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: on most workloads, and past thirty-two it stops returning anything at all.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: random_page_cost 1.1 exampledb.random_page_cost

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: -> On solid state storage a random read costs very nearly what a sequential one

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: does, and a planner told otherwise will avoid indexes it should be using.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: checkpoint_interval 300 s exampledb.checkpoint_interval

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: -> Longer intervals mean less write amplification and a longer recovery after a

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: crash. Five minutes is the point where most workloads stop noticing either.
